## Summary
Removes the unused breadcrumbs from the single-form and group form entry workflows: the empty `breadcrumbs-slot` and its wrapper, the `.breadcrumbsContainer` styles that targeted the old breadcrumbs widget's markup, and the `registerBreadcrumbs` call in `startupApp`.

Nothing renders into `breadcrumbs-slot` any more, because the app shell stopped registering its breadcrumbs widget in framework v9 (openmrs/openmrs-esm-core#1568). The slot rendered nothing, so the workflows' layout doesn't change.

title: (feat) Show the form name in the fast data entry workflows
body: ## Requirements - [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration. - [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui)) - [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests. ## Summary Shows the name of the form being filled in across the single-form and group form entry workflows. Neither workflow showed it before. The form's own page titles appear, but not the form's name, so there was no way to confirm which form was open. A new `FormName` component fetches the form's name and shows it in two places: - At the start of the action bar ("Next patient" or "Find group"), followed by a divider. Long names truncate with an ellipsis and show in full on hover. The bar's labels no longer wrap, so the name shrinks first when space runs out. - At the top of the right-hand panel, as a "Form" label above the name, while filling in a form or setting up a group session. The action bar is hidden in those states. The group session panel only shows it once a group is picked, since the action bar already shows it before then. This adds one translation key, `form`. The `PatientSearchHeader` and `GroupSessionWorkspace` tests mock `FormName`, since their framework mocks don't provide the fetch it uses. ## Screenshots ### Picking a patient | Before | After | |---|---| | | | ### Filling in a form ### Picking a group ### Long form name ## Related Issue ## Other The group session screens after picking a group aren't shown, because my local backend has no patient groups.

title: (chore) Capture E2E server logs with the shared capture-docker-logs action
body:
## Requirements

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

This PR replaces `jwalton/gh-docker-logs` in the E2E workflow with the org's shared [`capture-docker-logs`](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-contrib-gha-workflows/blob/main/.github/actions/capture-docker-logs/action.yml) action from [openmrs-contrib-gha-workflows#60](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-contrib-gha-workflows/pull/60). It does the same thing: it writes each container's logs to `logs/<container name>.log` for the upload step that follows.

`jwalton/gh-docker-logs` declares the Node 20 runtime, which GitHub [removed from hosted runners](https://github.blog/changelog/2025-09-19-deprecation-of-node-20-on-github-actions-runners/) on September 23. Runners now force it onto Node 24 with a deprecation warning. It hasn't had a release since v2.2.2 in January 2024, so there's no Node 24 version to upgrade to.

## Screenshots

## Related Issue

## Other

Same change as [openmrs-esm-core#1928](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core/pull/1928).

- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

This moves session cancellation, completion, group creation and editing, and patient-location confirmation to framework modals. Workflow callbacks are passed explicitly because the modals render outside the parent React context.

The dialogs close when the active workflow changes, and pending group saves only update the workflow that opened them. Cohort saves use a dedicated resource function, with save errors reported even if the dialog has been dismissed.

- [ ] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

The compressed-size action builds the pull request and base revisions sequentially in the same workspace. When the base build is restored from the Turborepo cache, its build command is skipped and stale pull-request chunks can remain in `dist`. Those files are then incorrectly reported as removed, inflating the bundle-size change.

This adds the action-supported cleanup hook and a package-owned `clean` script scoped to the ignored `dist` directory. Cleanup therefore runs independently of whether the subsequent build is executed or restored from cache.

This follows the workflow fix validated in openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart#3607.

## Summary

The e2e image kept the stale compressed importmap from the nightly image, which points at versioned app directories that the glob `COPY` flattens, so e2e runs time out waiting for the shell to load. This broke e2e CI in several O3 repos starting 2026-08-21.

This copies the frontend files with their directory structure intact and removes the stale compressed variants, so the freshly assembled importmap and routes registry are the ones served. Same fix as openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-management#2687.

title: (fix) Pin swr to 2.2.5 to match the app shell and avoid share-scope skew
body: ## Requirements - [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including a conventional commit label. - [ ] My work is based on designs - [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests. ## Summary `swr` is shared as a Module Federation singleton across the O3 frontend. This app declared it as a caret range, which floated up to `2.3.3`, while the app shell (`@openmrs/esm-app-shell`) and most apps (including `openmrs-esm-patient-chart`) pin `swr` exactly to `2.2.5`. With two `swr` minor versions in the shared scope, singleton resolution binds consumers by container init order. `swr/immutable` and `swr/infinite` at 2.3.3 bind against the shell's eager `swr/_internal` at 2.2.5, so `SWRGlobalState.get(cache)` returns `undefined` and the patient chart crashes on render (`TypeError: undefined is not iterable`), intermittently failing distro e2e runs. Pinning `swr` to `2.2.5` aligns this app with the app shell and removes its contribution to the skew. ## Screenshots ### Consistent undefined is not iterable error in Playwright trace ## Related Issue ## Other Resolves the intermittent patient chart crash seen in distro e2e runs (Module Federation `swr` share-scope skew). Part of a coordinated set of pins across the apps that had floated to 2.3.3; canonical PR: openmrs/openmrs-esm-billing-app#757.

body:
## Requirements

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/docs/frontend-modules/contributing.en-US#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [x] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

Migrates fast-data-entry-app's test runner from jest to vitest, aligning it with the patterns adopted across the rest of the O3 apps.

Changes:
- Replace `jest`, `@swc/jest`, `jest-cli`, `jest-environment-jsdom`, `@types/jest`, and `@types/testing-library__jest-dom` with `vitest`, `@vitest/coverage-v8`, `jsdom`, and `cross-env`. Bump `@testing-library/dom` (7.x to 10.x), `@testing-library/jest-dom` (5.x to 6.x), and `@testing-library/react` (13.x to 16.x) so the `/vitest` subpath is available.
- Add `vitest.config.ts`: `jsdom` environment, `.scss`/`.css` aliased to `identity-obj-proxy` via the anchored `^.*\.s?css$` regex, `@openmrs/esm-framework` aliased to its mock, `react-i18next` aliased to the local `__mocks__` file, and `fakeTimers.toFake` limited so it does not break React's scheduler.
- Replace `src/setup-tests.ts`'s `'@testing-library/jest-dom/extend-expect'` import with `'@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest'` and register `afterEach(cleanup)`.
- Convert the eleven test files to the vitest API: explicit imports for `describe`/`expect`/`it`/`vi` (plus `beforeEach`/`afterEach`/`type Mock`/`type MockedFunction` where used), `jest.*` swapped for `vi.*`. One `vi.mock(name, () => vi.fn())` factory wrapped in `{ default: vi.fn() }` for vitest's module-object shape requirement.
- Add explicit `as ConfigSchema` casts in `AddGroupModal.test.tsx` where the test reads properties off `mockUseConfig()` return value. Without the cast TypeScript sees the return as `unknown` because the framework's `useConfig` has no generic argument at the mock site.
- Delete `jest.config.json`.

Stacked on top of the `feat/migrate-to-rspack` branch so the rspack and vitest changes can land in sequence. Once rspack lands on `main`, please re-target this PR to `main`.

## Screenshots

N/A — tooling change only.

## Related Issue

N/A

## Other

All 36 tests pass locally. \`yarn lint\` and \`yarn typescript\` are green.

## Summary

Adds unit test coverage for several components and reducers that previously had none:

- **FormWorkflowReducer** — tests all action types (open form, set form, set encounter, close workspace, navigate)
- **GroupFormWorkflowReducer** — tests all action types including patient/form management, session editing, encounter submission, and validation
- **FormBootstrap** — tests widget state passing, post-response handling, and cleanup on unmount
- **GroupSessionWorkspace** — tests rendering of attendance table, session details, configurable questions, and form display across workflow states
- **SessionMetaWorkspace** — tests form rendering and submit behavior
- **GroupSearchHeader** — tests search visibility toggling, group selection, and conditional rendering

Also includes minor cleanup: eslint overrides for non-React files, type-only imports in e2e tests, typed `api` parameters in e2e helpers, and removal of unused `SideNavProps` type.
